label: Python

A01.remediation: Deny by default. Verify ownership / role on every route that reads a user id. Use Flask-Login / FastAPI dependencies and a per-object permission check (e.g. Pundit-style policy).

A02.remediation: Use bcrypt / argon2 (passlib.hash) for passwords, sha-256+ for general hashing. Use `secrets` module for tokens. Load secrets from env / vault.

A03.remediation: Use parameterised queries (`cursor.execute('SELECT … WHERE id = %s', (id,))`). Avoid `os.system` / `subprocess` with strings; pass argv lists. Use `ast.literal_eval` instead of `eval`.

A04.remediation: Add rate-limits with Flask-Limiter / SlowAPI. Resolve security-related TODO/FIXME comments before shipping.

A05.remediation: Set DEBUG = False in production. Restrict CORS to known origins. Set ALLOWED_HOSTS explicitly.

A07.remediation: Use `bcrypt.checkpw` / `argon2.verify` / Django's `check_password`. Enforce MFA via WebAuthn / TOTP (pyotp).

A08.remediation: Never unpickle untrusted bytes. Use `yaml.safe_load`. If you must use pickle, gate it behind HMAC + signature verification.

A09.remediation: Use the `logging` module. Log auth, authorization and admin events with user id, IP and timestamp. Never log passwords or tokens.

A10.remediation: Validate and allowlist outbound URLs. Resolve DNS yourself to block private/loopback addresses (169.254.169.254, 127.0.0.0/8, 10.0.0.0/8).

owaspRemediation.A01: Wrap routes with `@login_required`. Use FastAPI dependencies to load the current user and check `obj.owner_id == current_user.id`. Apply principle of least privilege.
owaspRemediation.A02: Use `passlib.hash.bcrypt` or `argon2-cffi`. Use `secrets.token_urlsafe(32)` for tokens. Move secrets to env / vault — never commit.
owaspRemediation.A03: Use `cursor.execute(sql, params)` with `%s` placeholders. Pass argv lists to subprocess. Replace eval with explicit dispatch tables.
owaspRemediation.A04: Apply Flask-Limiter / SlowAPI / django-ratelimit on auth endpoints. Resolve security TODOs before shipping.
owaspRemediation.A05: Set `DEBUG = False`, `ALLOWED_HOSTS = [...]`, restrict CORS origins. Ship a tight CSP.
owaspRemediation.A07: Use `bcrypt.checkpw` / `argon2.verify`. Verify JWTs with `algorithms=['HS256']`. Enforce MFA on high-value accounts.
owaspRemediation.A08: Never `pickle.load` untrusted data. Use `yaml.safe_load`. Use `itsdangerous` for signed tokens.
owaspRemediation.A09: Use the `logging` module with JSON formatter. Log every auth event with user id, IP, outcome.
owaspRemediation.A10: Validate URLs against an allowlist, resolve DNS yourself, block private IPs (incl. AWS metadata 169.254.169.254). Disable HTTP redirects on the client.
